info.name: Box Authorize Authorization File Version Retentions API

params.name: file_id
params.description: Filters results by files with this ID.

params.name: file_version_id
params.description: Filters results by file versions with this ID.

params.name: policy_id
params.description: Filters results by the retention policy with this ID.

params.name: disposition_action
params.description:
Filters results by the retention policy with this disposition
action.

params.name: disposition_before
params.description:
Filters results by files that will have their disposition
come into effect before this date.

params.name: disposition_after
params.description:
Filters results by files that will have their disposition
come into effect after this date.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: marker
params.description:
Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is
used when paginating using marker-based pagination.

This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.

items.docs: Retrieves all file version retentions for the given enterprise.

params.name: file_version_retention_id
params.description: The ID of the file version retention

items.docs: Returns information about a file version retention.
